market.purpose: Official description of versioned REST access to Epicor business objects processes reports BAQs and functions

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Tenant-owned reference to one provider endpoint identity secret binding detected version and administrative state.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP integrations commonly bind credentials and endpoints per company or environment.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Control Plane owns metadata and secret references; connector services consume them without exposing secret material.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Version-specific implementation behind a provider-neutral port that translates native operations into canonical contracts.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Epicor publishes versioned API surfaces whose available operations and authentication vary by installation.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Provider and version conditionals stay inside adapters; core domains never branch on Epicor version.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Independently enabled directional exchange with a declared system of record scope mapping idempotency checkpoint and conflict policy.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Enterprise integration suites separate flows so one failed object or direction does not disable all exchanges.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Every new object and direction requires its own CAPA and cannot inherit authority from provider enablement.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Explicit tenant-scoped relation from provider organization and location coordinates to UBP-owned identities.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP sites plants warehouses and bins are installation-specific and cannot be inferred safely by display name.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Missing or invalid mappings block affected rows; connectors never create organizational structure implicitly.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Manual idempotent initial load that reads external items and location balances then invokes canonical Inventory commands.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Initial ERP migrations commonly use bulk snapshots before incremental synchronization.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Bootstrap is not continuous sync; Inventory creates items and append-only movements and the connector never overwrites balances.

northStar.bestVersion: A tenant-governed integration fabric where providers and versions are isolated adapters, every flow is independently authorized and observable, and UBP domains remain the only owners and writers of business facts.
businessOutcomes: Connect a tenant to an ERP without customer forks or provider logic in UBP domains.
Bootstrap inventory with complete traceability and safe replay before enabling continuous synchronization.
Add providers and business flows through reusable contracts and governed mappings.
invariants: Every connection flow run and row is tenant-scoped and attributable.
Secrets never appear in reads logs events or functional audit payloads.
Connector services translate protocols and never write domain databases.
Every flow declares direction system of record idempotency checkpoints and conflict policy.
Inventory history remains append-only and domain-owned.
Unsupported provider versions fail explicitly instead of falling back to ungoverned access.
northStar.configurationBoundary: Provider catalog connection schema secret references supported versions organizational mappings flow activation and retry policy are Control Plane data; code changes only for a universal integration primitive or isolated provider adapter.

lessons.observedCapability: Epicor Kinetic exposes a versioned REST surface over business objects processes reports BAQs and functions.
lessons.lesson: A provider name alone is not a stable contract; version authentication and operation availability must be isolated and detected.
lessons.ubpDecision: Use one canonical connector port with separate Epicor 9 and 10 adapters, require native-operation proof per installation, and reject unsupported revisions explicitly.

gates.purpose: Validate the closed V11 expert and capability contracts.
Require active ownership approval pinned revision fresh market evidence and verified seeds.
Resolve Control Plane and Inventory ownership anchors against the pinned UBP graph.
Require tenant isolation secret redaction mapping validation idempotent replay and canonical Inventory writes before runtime readiness.

enforcement.readyWhen: The manifest is active with verified seeds and current evidence for the requested provider flow. Epicor runtime readiness remains BLOCK until connection adapters mappings bootstrap orchestration and end-to-end Inventory evidence exist.
